tess: quick flagging - canary after kernel-chooser tweak shows short-prompt p95 +17ms. looks host-side during tokenization/parse.

omar: hunch?

tess: extra normalize pass we added for fused-attn creates small memcopies and many tiny grpc writes into proxy. flame: syscalls spiking in write path.

ravi: can we coalesce at proxy (writev) as a quick fix?

tess: tried a 30m canary with proxy.coalesce.enabled=true and max_bytes=4096. results: syscalls -33%, p95 -11ms, kvcache-evictions -9%.

omar: nice. remaining issue is kvcache shard scatter during bursts - probably key variance from extra metadata + fragmentation.

ravi: plan: 1) proxy writev toggle + perf runs (omar) 2) host-side canonicalize KV keys before lookup (ravi) 3) add chooser per-model flag to skip normalize for vetted models (tess).

bench-bot: canary writev-coalesce deployed -> 2026-03-22T20:00:00Z

tess: i'll add a microbench for short-seq path and a small integration test for skipping normalize.

omar: i'll draft the proxy PR with unit tests and perf numbers.

ravi: i'll add telemetry: per-key shard_count, kvcache_evictions, small_write_rate.

tess: keep canary 2h, capture shard fanout + p95.
